description: Poll the local screen with OCR and return when the given text appears, or timeout. Useful for waiting on a dialog, button, or label to render before driving the UI further. Uses tesseract.js (English). Pass a `region` to drastically speed up OCR by limiting the searched area.

poll_interval_ms.description: Delay between OCR polls in ms (default 1000, min 250).

region.description: Optional crop {x, y, w, h} (px in screen space) to limit OCR — much faster than full-screen.

text.description: Substring to wait for in the OCR result.

timeout_ms.description: Max time to wait in ms (default 30000, max 300000).

name: jrd_wait_for_text
